ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there is a square with side length 4. Each side appears to be divided into two segments of equal length, and on each segment of a side a semicircle is drawn toward the interior of the square, so there are 8 congruent semicircles in total. The gray region is the part covered by only one semicircle; the lens-shaped regions formed by the overlap of two adjacent semicircles at the four corners are shown as white, and the uncovered region in the middle is also shown as white. Reasoning: Each side of the square has length 4, and each side is divided into two segments, so the diameter of each semicircle is 2 and the radius is 1. The total area of the 8 semicircles is 8 × (1/2 × π × 1^2) = 4π. At each corner, two adjacent semicircles of radius 1 overlap; the area of the overlapping lens is the area of two quarter-circles minus the area of a right triangle with side length 1, namely π/2 − 1. There are 4 such overlapping lenses in total. Since these overlapping parts are white in the figure and are not counted in the gray region, while in the total area of the semicircles each overlapping lens has been counted twice, the gray area = 4π − 2 × 4 × (π/2 − 1) = 8. The total area of the square is 4^2 = 16, therefore the white area = 16 − 8 = 8.

raw_record.question_text: Eight congruent semi-circles are drawn inside a square with side length 4. How big is the area of the white part?

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as a square whose four sides are each split into two equal segments, with one inward semicircle drawn on each half-side; thus the 8 congruent semicircles have diameter 2 and radius 1. The white region consists of the central uncovered region plus the four corner lens overlaps, because the overlapped parts of adjacent perpendicular semicircles are shown white rather than gray. Compute the gray area instead: the total area of all 8 semicircles is 8·(1/2·π·1^2)=4π. At each corner, two unit semicircles overlap in a lens formed by two quarter-circles minus a unit right triangle, so one lens has area π/2−1. There are 4 such lenses. Since the gray part is the area covered by exactly one semicircle, subtract each overlapped lens twice from the total semicircle area: gray area = 4π − 2·4(π/2−1)=8. The square area is 4^2=16, so the white area is 16−8=8.

图像描述：图中是一个边长为 4 的正方形。每条边看起来被分成两段相等的长度，每一段边上向正方形内部画了一个半圆，所以共有 8 个全等半圆。灰色区域是只被一个半圆覆盖的部分；四个角上两个相邻半圆重叠形成的透镜形区域显示为白色，中间未覆盖区域也显示为白色。

推理：正方形每边长 4，每条边分成两段，所以每个半圆的直径为 2，半径为 1。8 个半圆的总面积为 8 × (1/2 × π × 1^2) = 4π。每个角上两个半径为 1 的相邻半圆重叠，重叠透镜面积为两个四分之一圆面积减去一个边长为 1 的直角三角形面积，即 π/2 − 1。共有 4 个这样的重叠透镜。由于这些重叠部分在图中是白色，不计入灰色区域，而半圆总面积中每个重叠透镜被计算了两次，所以灰色面积 = 4π − 2 × 4 × (π/2 − 1) = 8。正方形总面积为 4^2 = 16，因此白色面积 = 16 − 8 = 8。
